svg.title: Goodhart's law
svg.desc: A chat app's SLO counts sends without a 5xx at the load balancer. The send API now answers 202 the moment a message is queued, so the number climbs from 99.9% to 99.99%. A delivery worker bug backs the queue up for 40 minutes and nothing arrives, but the number never moves. Counting at the recipient's device instead, within 5 seconds, gives a worse but truer 99.6%.
svg.text: counted on the device, within 5 s
The number stayed at 99.99% while messages sat in a queue for 40 minutes.
